data.title: Summer
data.about:
Summer is no longer just a season. Now, it’s a place where you can live an extraordinary lifestyle. At SUMMER Dubai in Creek Harbour, feel every moment and embrace an exclusive beach-side community where you can bask in world-class lifestyle offerings, a fusion of leisure and retail amenities, lively verdant courtyards, and many more. Be laid-back, be carefree, be happy. It’s SUMMER!

Family Conveniences Like No Other

At SUMMER, you and your family are the ultimate priority. It’s the best place where you can enjoy a range of amenities and conveniences ranging from eateries, to on-site health facilities, a large supermarket, and many more. Name it, and you’ll find it here.

The City’s Tropical Paradise

Located at the famous Creek Beach, which strategically combines beach charm with urban convenience, SUMMER Dubai in Creek Harbour is set to be a sensational residential destination for fun-loving families who dream of waking up every day in a tropical paradise in the heart of the Middle East. Here is the best place to experience a daily summer getaway brought by mesmerising sunset views, licensed restaurants and bars, beach activities, exclusive entertainment venues, and many more.

location_tile.title: Located in Dubai Creek Harbour, SUMMER Creek Beach is where the best moments of your life await you.
location_tile.heading: location
location_tile.description:
This posh residential area set in a serene beach-side community is only 10 to 15 minutes away from Dubai’s prime landmarks.

  • 5 Min From A Major Highway
  • 5 Min From Dubai Creek Tower
  • Steps Away From Creek Tower Bridge
  • 10 Min From Burj Khalifa
  • 15 Min From Dubai Int’l Airport
